model.deck_model: D2: loads and mass, no deck stiffness
model.nonlinear_component: N1/S1 linear buckling about the computed static state

kkt_diagnostic.note: Least-squares active-set multiplier estimate. Feasibility is tight; stationarity is approximate rather than machine-converged.

with_without_R5.full_physics_polish_outcome: A direct full-physics SLSQP polish attempted lower-mass steps, but those trial points lost feasibility through R2/R6 while R5 remained far inactive; rejected trial points were not reported as an optimum.
with_without_R5.conclusion: R5 is inactive at the locally refined design; restoring the full R2-R6 physics does not change the accepted incumbent because R2 and R6 already govern.

viewer_notes.member_thickness: Rendered at true CHS outer radius by default; the thickness control can exaggerate it for visibility.
viewer_notes.deformation: Static and eigenmode curves use cubic Euler-Bernoulli/Hermite interpolation with exported end translations and rotations.
viewer_notes.stress_color: Single-hue sequential scale of fatigue stress utilization. A geometric ring marks elements above the fatigue limit so failure is not conveyed by color alone.
